description: Lock a price (10 minutes) for a BATCH of travel eSIMs paid in one payment: N claim links, one per person, for a group trip, a conference delegation or event giveaways. Each eSIM is bought when its link is claimed (the person opens it on their phone and installs the QR), and links nobody claims within 30 days are refunded to the paying wallet. Free. Pay the returned quoteId with `buy`, or send the human to this service's /pay/?mode=vouchers page to buy it with their own wallet. Limits: 2–50 eSIMs, each within the per-order limit, the batch within its own limit ($100 by default). ALWAYS show the human the total and the count before buying.

count.description: how many eSIMs, i.e. claim links

note.description: shown on every claim page, e.g. 'Devcon 8 delegation'

offerId.description: an esim offer from list_offers type=esim

payer.description: the Algorand address you will pay from
